cues.passage: A wide, flat plain of dark red sand under a butterscotch sky. One small machine stands on it, beside its own long shadow.
cues.arrival: Opportunity, close: a rover the size of a golf cart, with six wheels, a flat deck of dark blue solar panels and a camera mast. Its tracks lead away behind it.
cues.sol1: The rover on the plain, seen from above. Three places are marked: the open plain ahead, a pale rock beside the rover, and the rover itself.
cues.drive: The rover rolls slowly across the plain. Two thin tracks grow behind its wheels.
cues.science: The rover has stopped at a pale rock. In the sand around it lie tiny round gray grains, smaller than peas.
cues.rest: The rover stands still on the plain. A thin layer of tan dust covers its solar panels.
cues.wind: A gust of wind carries pale dust low across the plain and over the rover. Behind it the solar panels are dark blue and clean again.
cues.plan: The planner's view from high above: a crater on the plain, and the rover near it inside a white ring. One wall of the crater is bright with sunlight. The floor under the opposite wall lies in shadow. A gold ring marks the waypoint.
cues.parked: The rover stands where the sequence sent it. A long shadow shows that the Sun is low.
cues.storm: The view from the rover's camera mast, toward the Sun. The sky turns from butterscotch to dark brown. The Sun shrinks until it is one faint dot.
cues.dark: Noon looks like night. The rover is a dark shape in brown air full of dust.
cues.berries: Very close to the ground: tiny gray spheres lie in the sand and stick out of a pale rock.
cues.rim: The edge of the crater. Its walls are pale rock, brighter than the sand of the plain.
cues.clew: The rover, small and far away, in dim brown light.
cues.status: Opportunity stands still in thin haze. Tan dust covers its solar panels.
cues.file: The rover turns slowly so you can see every side.
